SER Series (Set Screw Type, Narrow Width Insert, Snap Ring)

These are SER insert bearings fixed to the shaft with two set screws (locking screws) and a snap ring. They use a cylindrical outer ring, and their housing specifications differ from SA/CSA, making them a separate, non-interchangeable series.
